entities.summary: Florian Stablewski of the Oksza coat of arms was a Polish Roman Catholic cleric, a deputy to the Prussian Landtag from 1876 to 1891, the Metropolitan Archbishop of Gniezno and Poznań, and the Primate of Poland from 1891 to 1906.
